chunks: According to what Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated, he said:

Abu al-Hasan al-Askari (peace be upon him) wrote to Ali ibn Amr al-Qazwini in his own handwriting: 'Have certainty in that through which you worship Allah the Almighty, that the inward [reality] with me is as I have shown you regarding the one you asked about, and he is Faras; may Allah curse him. For you have no choice but to strive in cursing him, targeting him, and being hostile to him, and to exaggerate in that as much as you can find the way to do. I did not command that Allah be worshipped through an incorrect matter, so strive and be firm in cursing him, exposing him, cutting off his sources, and turning our companions away from him, and invalidating his affair, and convey that to them from me, and narrate to them from me. And indeed, I will ask you before Allah regarding this emphasized matter, so woe to the disobedient and to the denier. And I wrote with my own hand on the night of Tuesday, for nine nights that passed from the month of Rabi' al-Awwal, in the year fifty and two hundred, and I rely on Allah and thank Him much.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Askari command regarding Faras in his letter to Ali ibn Amr?
ai.summary: In this letter from the *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Askari (a.s.) clarifies that the 'batin' (inner reality) of Faras aligns with his outward appearance, commanding Ali ibn Amr to engage in *al-lan* (cursing) and *al-mu'ada* (hostility) as acts of worship. This directive underscores the Shia doctrine of *al-wala' wa al-barra'* (loyalty and enmity), where actively opposing the specific enemy of the Imam is a religious obligation. The Imam’s emphasis on 'ijtihad' in cursing highlights that this enmity is not merely passive but requires vigorous effort to sever ties and expose the enemy's falsehood.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 312 - Abdullah bin Ja’far Himyari said:

Imam Hadi (a.s) wrote the following letter in his own handwriting addressed to Ali bin Umar Qazwini: “Have certitude in that through which you worship the Almighty Allah, whose inward is with me. With regard to one about whom you asked and that is Faras; may Allah curse him. Concentrate your efforts to curse and be inimical to him and put in this matter more effort than is possible. I am not saying that you worship Almighty Allah through incorrect issues and I don’t order you an incorrect belief. Thus try more to curse and to be inimical and to oppose him. Keep my companions away from him and refute his orders and dogmas and announce to the Shia on my behalf that I am indeed going to ask you about it in the court of the Almighty Allah. Thus woe be on one who is disobedient and is a denier of mastership (Wilayat). I have written this letter in my own handwriting on Tuesday eve, eve of the 9th Rabiul Awwal, 250 A.H. I have relied on Almighty Allah and am extremely thankful to Him.”
